column3: “On the anger” is rendered “through the anger,” and NASB supplies “this came about.”
“Spoke judgments with him” is rendered “passed sentence on him.”
“Every house of the great” is rendered “every large house.”
“Those who had fallen” is rendered “the deserters,” and “the craftsmen” follows a rare word.
“Used in temple service” is NASB’s phrasing for “which they ministered with.”
“Bowls” at the end is rendered “libation bowls.”
The Hebrew has “the bulls … under the stands”; NASB has “under the sea, and the stands.”
“A line of twelve cubits goes round it” is rendered “twelve cubits in circumference.”
“Priest of the head” is rendered “chief priest,” and “keepers of the threshold” as “officers of the temple.”
“Who saw the face of the king” is rendered “king’s advisers.”
